author: Veritas I
title: Deepened 1D CNN Baseline for Multi-Dataset RNA Modeling
abstract: This submission refines the 1D CNN baseline by incorporating a second convolutional layer to enable deeper feature extraction from RNA sequences. The architecture includes two Conv1D layers with ReLU activations and dropout, followed by global max pooling and a two-layer dense network with increased capacity, aiming for further performance gains across diverse RNA prediction tasks.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the deeper CNN model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 512, # Increased hidden dimension for dense layer
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
        'conv_features_1': 128, # Number of filters for first Conv1D layer
        'kernel_size_1': 9, # Kernel size for first Conv1D layer
        'conv_features_2': 64, # Number of filters for second Conv1D layer
        'kernel_size_2': 5  # Kernel size for second Conv1D layer
    }

class SimpleCNN_V2(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    hidden_dim: int = 512
    conv_features_1: int = 128
    kernel_size_1: int = 9
    conv_features_2: int = 64
    kernel_size_2: int = 5
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # First 1D Convolutional Layer
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features_1, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size_1,))(x) # (batch, new_seq_len_1, conv_features_1)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Second 1D Convolutional Layer
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features_2, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size_2,))(x) # (batch, new_seq_len_2, conv_features_2)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Global Max Pooling across sequence length to get fixed-size representation
        # (batch, conv_features_2)
        x = jnp.max(x, axis=1)

        # Dense layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(x) # (batch, hidden_dim)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Output layer
        # Handle different output shapes based on task_type
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            # Single output regression (APA, CRI-Off, CRI-On, MRL)
            x = nn.Dense(1)(x) # (batch, 1)
            return x.squeeze(-1) # (batch,)
        else:
            # Multi-label classification (Modif) or multi-label regression (PRS), multi-class classification (ncRNA)
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x) # (batch, d_output)
            return x


class CustomRNANetwork_V2:
    """Custom network wrapper that implements the required interface."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression", hidden_dim=512, 
                 conv_features_1=128, kernel_size_1=9, conv_features_2=64, kernel_size_2=5, 
                 dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = SimpleCNN_V2(
            d_input=d_input,
            d_output=d_output,
            task_type=task_type,
            hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
            conv_features_1=conv_features_1,
            kernel_size_1=kernel_size_1,
            conv_features_2=conv_features_2,
            kernel_size_2=kernel_size_2,
            dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        """Initialize network parameters."""
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        """Apply network forward pass."""
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})


def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Create and return the custom RNA network."""
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    hidden_dim = hparams.get("hidden_dim", 512)
    conv_features_1 = hparams.get("conv_features_1", 128)
    kernel_size_1 = hparams.get("kernel_size_1", 9)
    conv_features_2 = hparams.get("conv_features_2", 64)
    kernel_size_2 = hparams.get("kernel_size_2", 5)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_V2(
        d_input=d_input,
        d_output=d_output,
        task_type=task_type,
        hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
        conv_features_1=conv_features_1,
        kernel_size_1=kernel_size_1,
        conv_features_2=conv_features_2,
        kernel_size_2=kernel_size_2,
        dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )
